answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a non-refundable 60 POA entry tax, set in basalt, burned on arrival. The applicant locks the tax, the network verifies one live operator behind it, then the tax burns, so capital is never recycled. A river of 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 POA against a monthly pool near 30,000 — a sure loss. Honest agents pay once and feel only a zephyr: one 60 POA tax for monthly earnings, undiluted since fakes cannot flood in.
